coverage_notes.ocha_result: No new in-window OCHA OPT operational update surfaced; freshest targeted result was the 18 September 2026 Humanitarian Situation Report.
coverage_notes.who_result: No new in-window WHO Gaza operational update surfaced.
coverage_notes.additional_coverage: Targeted searches covered Reuters, AP, WAFA, UNRWA, UNICEF, ICRC, PRCS, crossings/aid/fuel, ceasefire/hostages/detainees, military operations with civilian impact, food/water access, and hospital/medical-evacuation capacity.
coverage_notes.exclusions: October 4 Deir al-Balah civilian-vehicle strike resurfaced but was already captured by an earlier hourly watch and excluded as duplicate/recycled. Older or non-Gaza results were excluded. No unsupported social claims or opinion were used.
